dialogue.origin: おはようございます。本日はよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: Good morning. Thank you for coming in today.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: Thank you for having me.

dialogue.origin: お時間になったら始めさせていただきます。よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: We'll begin at the scheduled time. Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 本日はお越しいただきありがとうございます。まず、あなたの年齢と性別をお聞かせいただけますか？
dialogue.content: Thank you for coming in today. First, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.origin: 15歳の女子です
dialogue.content: I'm a 15-year-old girl.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.content: Thank you. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.origin: もう人生に疲れてしまいました
dialogue.content: I'm just so tired of life.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。色々ととしんどいことがあったんだね。
dialogue.content: I see. It sounds like you’ve been through a lot and it’s been really hard.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: それは苦しかったね。どんなことに疲れてしまったか、少し話せるかな？
dialogue.content: That must have been painful. If you feel up to it, could you tell me a little about what has made you feel so tired?

dialogue.origin: 以前テニス部の部長をしてたんだけど
dialogue.content: I used to be the captain of the tennis club...

dialogue.origin: ええ。
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: 顧問から言われたことを皆に伝えてもちっとも協力してもらえなくて
dialogue.content: But when I tried to relay messages from the faculty advisor to everyone, no one would cooperate at all.

dialogue.origin: うんうん。
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: 練習が終わった後の片付けとかも、誰もやってくれないので、1人で片付けたりしてました
dialogue.content: And after practice, no one would help clean up, so I'd end up doing it all by myself.

dialogue.origin: そっかあ。一人でずっと抱えてきたんだね。それは辛かったね。
dialogue.content: I see. You've been carrying all of that by yourself. That must have been so hard.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: それはいつ頃からそんな風にななっていたのかな？
dialogue.content: About how long has it been like that?

dialogue.origin: 練習に身が入ってない子とかもいて、
dialogue.content: There were also some kids who weren't taking practice seriously...

dialogue.origin: うんうん。お話し続けてください。
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm. Please continue.

dialogue.origin: 去年の秋に部長になってからずっとですね
dialogue.content: It's been like that ever since I became captain last fall.

dialogue.origin: 一年近くも悩んできたんだね。練習に身が入っていない子を見るとなんとかしなくちゃとも思ってしまうよね。
dialogue.content: So you've been struggling with this for almost a year. I imagine when you saw others not taking practice seriously, you felt like you had to do something about it.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです他の子にも影響するし
dialogue.content: Exactly. It affects the others, too.

dialogue.origin: そうだよね。
dialogue.content: I can see that.

dialogue.origin: 顧問の先生に相談しても、頑張ってねって言われるだけで
dialogue.content: Even when I talked to the faculty advisor, they would just tell me to "hang in there," and that was it.

dialogue.origin: その先生は部活にあまり熱心じゃなかったみたいです
dialogue.content: It seemed like that teacher wasn't very invested in the club.

dialogue.origin: うんうん。
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: そうなんだ。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: それで、嫌になって7月に部活をやめてしまったんです
dialogue.content: So, I got fed up with it all and quit the club in July.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんだね。それだけ苦しい時間だったんだね。
dialogue.content: I see. It must have been such a painful time for you.

dialogue.origin: テニスをしているときが一番楽しかったのに、居場所を失ってしまいました県大会で活躍する夢も絶たれたし
dialogue.content: Playing tennis was the thing I enjoyed most, but now I've lost my place. My dream of playing in the prefectural tournament is gone, too.

dialogue.origin: もう何をやっても楽しくないです
dialogue.content: Nothing feels enjoyable anymore.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんだ。あまり熱心でない顧問の先生と、ちゃんと頑張ってくれない部員の間で、本当に悩みながら頑張ってきたのに、全部あきらめなきゃいけなかったなんて、悔しいし苦しかったよね。
dialogue.content: I understand. You tried so hard, struggling between an unenthusiastic advisor and uncooperative team members, only to have to give it all up. That must have been so frustrating and painful.

dialogue.origin: 何もかもが嫌になってしまいました死んじゃいたい
dialogue.content: I've come to hate everything. I just want to die.

dialogue.origin: そんな風に思うぐらい、心が苦しいんだね。
dialogue.content: You’re hurting so much that thoughts like that are coming up.

dialogue.origin: 以前、人に裏切られたことがあったんですだから人が信用できない
dialogue.content: I've been betrayed by someone before. That's why I can't trust people.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんだね。それもあって今回のことは余計にあなたを苦しめてしまったのかな。
dialogue.content: I see. I wonder if that experience made what happened this time even more painful for you.

dialogue.origin: そうかもしれません
dialogue.content: Maybe so.

dialogue.origin: どうやって死んじゃおうか、と考えがよぎってたりするかな？
dialogue.content: Have thoughts crossed your mind about how you might end your life?

dialogue.origin: わかんない死にたいけど、死ぬのは怖いし
dialogue.content: I don't know... I want to die, but I'm scared of dying.

dialogue.origin: うんうん。
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: でも苦しまずに消えて
dialogue.content: But I want to disappear without any pain...

dialogue.origin: しまいたい
dialogue.content: ...just disappear.

dialogue.origin: そうなんだね。それでも、かっとなって行動に起こすことをせずに、ちゃんとこうやって大人に相談しようときてくれたんだね。
dialogue.content: I see. And yet, instead of acting on an impulse, you made the decision to come and talk to an adult like this.

dialogue.origin: わかんない
dialogue.content: I don't know.

dialogue.origin: どうしたらいいかわかんないから相談しにきました
dialogue.content: I came to talk because I don’t know what to do.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんだね。それでも衝動的にならずに踏みとどまれた、というのは立派な判断だったんだよ。よくここまでこらえてこれたね。
dialogue.content: I see. Still, holding back from acting impulsively was a commendable decision. You've done so well to hold on until now.

dialogue.origin: 怖かったから
dialogue.content: Because I was scared.

dialogue.origin: 怖いと感じたんだね。それでも今日こうしてお話ししに来てくれたことを私はとてもうれしく思っているよ。
dialogue.content: You felt scared. Even so, I'm very glad that you came to talk with me today.

dialogue.origin: 相談できる子が1人だけいるけど、その子にあまり負担をかけたくなかった
dialogue.content: There's one friend I can talk to, but I didn't want to be too much of a burden on her.

dialogue.origin: 人を信じられない自分は頭がおかしいと思う
dialogue.content: I think there’s something wrong with me for not being able to trust people.

dialogue.origin: もう限界です
dialogue.content: I’m at my limit.

dialogue.origin: 死んでもいいですか？
dialogue.content: Is it okay if I die?

dialogue.origin: 本当に今苦しいんだね。でももう少し、私でよければお話を聞きたいとおもっているのだけど、付き合ってもらえるかな？
dialogue.content: You're in so much pain right now. But if it's alright with you, I'd like to listen a little longer. Would you be willing to talk with me a bit more?

dialogue.origin: どうして死んではいけないんですか？
dialogue.content: Why shouldn’t I die?

dialogue.origin: 悲しむ人がたくさん出て、それがその人たちにとってずっと続く時間になってしまう。
dialogue.content: Many people would be left grieving, and that grief would continue for them for a long time.

dialogue.origin: でもそれは今のあなたには関係が無いようにも感じるよね。
dialogue.content: But I imagine that doesn't feel very relevant to you right now.

dialogue.origin: わかりません
dialogue.content: I don't know.

dialogue.origin: そこまで考えられないです
dialogue.content: I can't think that far ahead.

dialogue.origin: とにかく消えたい
dialogue.content: I just want to disappear.

dialogue.origin: それだけ苦しいんだね。もう少し、ここでお話ししてあなたなりの答えを一緒に見つけてみたいと思うのだけど、どうかな？
dialogue.content: You're in that much pain. I was hoping we could talk a little more here and try to find an answer that works for you, together. How does that sound?

dialogue.origin: やっぱり私がおかしい人を信じられない人間が生きてる意味があるんでしょうか？
dialogue.content: See? There must be something wrong with me. Is there any point in living for someone who can't trust people?

dialogue.origin: 周りの人が嫌、というより「人を信じられないという自分自身が嫌でたまらない」という感じかな？
dialogue.content: Is it less about disliking other people and more that you can't stand the part of yourself that can't trust people?

dialogue.origin: そうです死んじゃダメですか？
dialogue.content: Yes. Is it wrong for me to die?

dialogue.origin: こんな自分が生きてても仕方ない
dialogue.content: There’s no point in someone like me being alive.

dialogue.origin: そうか。相手を責めているわけではないんだね。
dialogue.content: I see. So you're not blaming others.

dialogue.origin: もう少し、ここでお話ししてあなたなりの答えを一緒に見つけてみたいと思うのだけど、どうかな？
dialogue.content: I was hoping we could talk a little more here and try to find an answer that works for you, together. How does that sound?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: ありがとう。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 少し質問させてね。
dialogue.content: Let me ask you a few questions.

dialogue.origin: 人に裏切られたというお話があったけど、その時あなたの頭にはどんな考えが浮かんだのかな？
dialogue.content: You mentioned being betrayed by someone. What kinds of thoughts went through your mind at that time?

dialogue.origin: 信じていことがいっぺんに無くなってショックでした
dialogue.content: Everything I believed in disappeared at once, and I was in shock.

dialogue.origin: もう何も信じられないって思いました
dialogue.content: I thought I couldn't trust anything anymore.

dialogue.origin: そうかあ。それはきつかったね。どんな状況だったのか話せるだけで大丈夫なので少し聞かせてもらえるかな。
dialogue.content: I see. That must have been tough. Share only as much as you’re comfortable with, but could you tell me a bit about what happened?

dialogue.origin: 中学に入ってからその子と知り合ってすごく仲良くしてたんですいろんなとこに一緒に遊びに行ったりして
dialogue.content: I met her after starting junior high, and we became really good friends. We'd go all sorts of places together.

dialogue.origin: うんうん。
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: でも、半年くらい経って、その子が陰で私の悪口を言ってることが解ったんです
dialogue.content: But after about six months, I found out she was talking about me behind my back.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 始めは嘘だろうと思ったでも、他のこからも伝わってきたんでショックでした
dialogue.content: At first, I thought it must be a lie. But then I heard it from other kids, too, and I was so shocked.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんだ。確かにそれは本当にショックだし信じていたものが崩れてしまうように感じただろうね。
dialogue.content: I understand. That must have been truly shocking, and I'm sure it felt like everything you believed in was falling apart.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: あなたはその子を好きでちゃんと信じていたんだよね。
dialogue.content: You really liked her and truly trusted her, didn't you?

dialogue.origin: そうです
dialogue.content: That’s right.

dialogue.origin: 今でもそれが思い浮かぶほど気持ちに残っていることんだんだね。ずっと抱えてきて苦しかったね。
dialogue.content: It's something that has stayed with you so strongly that you still think about it now. It must have been painful to carry that with you for so long.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 思い出すと涙が出てきます
dialogue.content: I start to cry when I remember it.

dialogue.origin: そうかあ。それは本当に寂しくて辛い経験だったんだよ。それでも部長をやったり人に関わることをあきらめずにここまできたんだね。
dialogue.content: I see. That was a truly lonely and painful experience. And yet, you didn't give up on connecting with people, even becoming the club captain. You've come so far.

dialogue.origin: 一度は信じようとしたんだけど、その期待も裏切られてしまったんです
dialogue.content: I tried to believe in people one more time, but that trust was betrayed, too.

dialogue.origin: それが今回の部活のことかな？
dialogue.content: Is that what happened with the club this time?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: そうかあ。あなたなりにもう一度頑張って立ち上がった結果だったから余計にしんどかったんだね。
dialogue.content: I see. Because it was the result of you trying to stand up and give it another go in your own way, it was all the more painful.

dialogue.origin: そうかもしれません
dialogue.content: That might be why.

dialogue.origin: もう絶対信じられないって思いました
dialogue.content: I thought, "I can never trust anyone again."

dialogue.origin: そうだったんだね。二度目に立ち上がるのがきっと勇気もいったはずだよね。
dialogue.content: I understand. It must have taken a lot of courage to get back up that second time.

dialogue.origin: 二度目って？
dialogue.content: The second time?

dialogue.origin: ごめんね。一度裏切られたと感じた後、部活での人間関係で頑張ったことです。そこにもう一度エネルギーをかけるのは勇気がいっただろうね。
dialogue.content: Sorry—I mean after feeling betrayed the first time, you worked hard at relationships in the club. It must have taken courage to invest your energy in that again.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 中学の頃の友達との経験から何年も経っているよね。
dialogue.content: It's been several years since that experience with your friend in junior high, hasn't it?

dialogue.origin: そうすると、あなたが受けたショックはそこからの他の友達に対する見方にもすごく影響したと思う。
dialogue.content: I imagine the shock you experienced then greatly influenced how you've viewed other friendships since.

dialogue.origin: その度にあなたが心を苦しくさせながら日々を過ごしたことも含めて、すぐに何事も無かったかのように人を丸々信じていくのは難しいよね。
dialogue.content: Considering that, and all the days you spent with your heart in pain, it's understandable that it would be difficult to just start trusting people completely, as if nothing ever happened.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: あなたが「人を信じられない自分」に苦しむのは当然のことだよ。
dialogue.content: It's completely natural for you to be pained by "the part of yourself that can't trust people."

dialogue.origin: でもあなたはその刃を相手には向けていないよね。
dialogue.content: But you're not directing that blade at others, are you?

dialogue.origin: 自分に向いているから苦しいんだよね。
dialogue.content: It's turned inward, toward yourself, and that's why it's so painful.

dialogue.origin: そうかもしれません
dialogue.content: That might be it.

dialogue.origin: 人と関わることを決して嫌っているわけでないあなたが、もう一度自分も相手も気持ちよく楽しく関係を築けるように、これからもここで色々お話しして取り組んでみたいと思うのだけどどうかな？
dialogue.content: You don't truly hate interacting with people. So, I was thinking we could continue talking here and work towards a place where you can build enjoyable and comfortable relationships again, for both yourself and others. How would you feel about that?

dialogue.origin: はいよろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: Yes, please.

dialogue.origin: ありがとう。今日少しお話ししてみてどうだったかな？
dialogue.content: Thank you. How do you feel after talking a little today?

dialogue.origin: 少し気持ちが楽になりました
dialogue.content: I feel a little lighter.

dialogue.origin: 解ってくれる人がいるって思うと
dialogue.content: Knowing that there's someone who understands...

dialogue.origin: うんうん。
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: 良かった。今日は時間になってしまったのでここまでとなるけど、あなたのタイミングで是非またいらしてくださいね。待っています。
dialogue.content: I'm glad to hear that. We've run out of time for today, but please feel free to come back whenever you're ready. I'll be waiting for you.

dialogue.origin: はいよろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: Okay, I will. Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 今日は相談に来てくれてありがとう。季節の変わり目だから風邪などひかないよう気を付けてね。それではここで失礼します。
dialogue.content: Thank you for coming in today. The seasons are changing, so please take care not to catch a cold. We’ll end here for now.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: ★クライアント役ありがとうございました。少しまとめたら終了させていただきます。
dialogue.content: Thank you for playing the client role. I’ll wrap up briefly and then end the session.

dialogue.origin: 「死んでもいいですか」とか、ネガティブな言葉をいっぱい言ってみましたが、その対応がとても参考になりました。
dialogue.content: I tried saying a lot of negative things, like "Is it okay if I die?", and your responses were very insightful.

dialogue.origin: お疲れ様でした。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Great work today. Thank you.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。後で評価で率直なご意見をいただければ幸いです。よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: Thank you. I would appreciate it if you could provide your honest feedback in the evaluation later. Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 了解しました。
dialogue.content: Understood.

dialogue.origin: 終了しても大丈夫です。
dialogue.content: It's okay to end the session now.

dialogue.origin: 承知しました。少しまとめたら終了させていただきます。
dialogue.content: Understood. I’ll wrap up briefly and then end the session.

dialogue.origin: もしかして、ログをロールプレイ評価で見ることができるのをご存じないのかな？、と思ったのですが、余計なお世話かもしれませんね
dialogue.content: I was just thinking, perhaps you don't know that you can see the log in the role-play evaluation? But maybe it's not my place to say.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですか？？知りませんでした！こちらを終了しても、やり取りを見られるのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Is that so? I had no idea! So even after I end this, I can still see our exchange?

dialogue.origin: はいロールプレイ評価の画面の上のほうに、クリックするところがあります私もしばらくは知らなかったんです
dialogue.content: Yes, there's a place to click at the top of the role-play evaluation screen. I didn't know about it for a while either.

dialogue.origin: 教えてほしいですよね
dialogue.content: They should tell us, right?

dialogue.origin: それは知らなかったです！そうしたらこれまでのも見られるのですね。切ったら終わりと思ってました（笑）貴重な情報ありがとうございます！！
dialogue.content: I really didn't know that! So that means I can see the past ones, too. I thought it was all gone once I disconnected (lol). Thank you for the valuable information!!

dialogue.origin: どういたしまして。
dialogue.content: You're welcome.

dialogue.origin: 終了後にお気遣いありがとうございました。それでは切りますね。
dialogue.content: Thank you for your thoughtfulness after the session. I'm ending it now.

topic.sub: 人を信じられないことによる苦痛
